welcome.title: What went wrong?
welcome.description: AI will review your recent order and start resolving it right away.

issues.description: You can also describe it yourself.

chat.intro: I found your order. Tell me what went wrong and I’ll check the required data and take the next action.
chat.draftReady: I drafted a message from your selection. Review it and send it when ready.
chat.requiredHint: Please attach a photo so we can verify the wrong delivery.

quickDraft.delay: The estimated arrival time has passed, but my delivery is not here yet.
quickDraft.missing: The fries from my order were missing.
quickDraft.wrong: I received food that is different from what I ordered.

state.ready: Tell me what you need resolved

analysis.delay: I checked the delivery data. The order is 18 minutes past its ETA and the rider is heading from the restaurant toward you. I can enable live updates or check delay compensation now.
analysis.missing: I verified that one order of fries is included. After checking the price and CS history, I can check instant refund eligibility or ask the restaurant to confirm packing.
analysis.wrong: I compared your order and photo. The delivered food appears different from your order. I can request redelivery now or send the full context to a human agent.

tools.delay: Checked order, rider location, and ETA
tools.missing: Checked ordered items, prices, and refund history
tools.wrong: Compared ordered items, photo, and delivery data
tools.refundPolicyChecked: Checked price, refund policy, and duplicate refunds
tools.merchantRequested: Created a merchant confirmation and sent an alert
tools.redeliveryCreated: Created a redelivery order and notified the restaurant
tools.escalationCreated: Escalated the order, photo, and AI findings
tools.refundExecuted: Requested a partial refund to the original payment method
tools.noAction: Kept the current delivery without an additional action

results.trackingDone: Live delivery updates are on. I’ll notify you when the location or ETA changes. You can keep asking for help in this chat.
results.compensationOffer: The delay policy applies. Would you like me to issue a ₩3,000 coupon now?
results.refundOffer: This meets the automated resolution policy. I can refund ₩3,500 for the missing fries to your original payment method.
results.merchantPending: I sent the restaurant a confirmation request. When they reply, the Agent will automatically continue in this chat. Progress is saved if you close the page.
results.redeliveryDone: Redelivery is confirmed. The restaurant has started preparing it and the new ETA is 8:20 PM. You can track it in this chat.
results.escalationDone: I sent the order, photo, and findings so the agent can decide immediately. You won’t need to explain everything again.
results.couponDone: Your ₩3,000 delay coupon has been issued. You can find it in Coupons. Is there anything else to resolve?
results.refundDone: The ₩3,500 refund is complete. It may take 2–3 business days to appear on your original payment method.
results.noAction: Got it. The current delivery will continue, and I’ll post any status changes in this chat.

agent.followUp: I still have the order details and actions from this case. I’ve received your follow-up and can continue from here.

processing.title: AI is checking your order
processing.description: Please wait while we securely review the details we need.

delay.title: We confirmed a delivery delay
delay.description: The order is 18 minutes past its ETA. Your rider is on the way and no extra evidence is needed.

missing.title: We asked the restaurant to confirm
missing.description: We verified that fries were included in your order. AI will continue once the restaurant responds.

wrong.title: Your evidence was submitted
wrong.description: We sent the order details and photo together. A human agent is reviewing the case.

trust.title: What AI checks
trust.note: We only check necessary information. If AI cannot resolve it, a human agent receives the full context.
